info.name: Looker Studio Get an embedded report page

params.name: reportId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Looker Studio report to embed.

params.name: pageId
params.description: The identifier of the specific page within the report to display.

params.name: params
params.description: URL-encoded JSON string containing filter parameters to apply to the embedded report. Filters restrict the data displayed based on dimension values.

items.docs: Returns an embeddable version of a Looker Studio report page designed for use within an HTML iframe. The embedded report renders the specified page of the report with optional filter parameters. Users must have at least view access to the report to see the embedded content.

info.name: Looker Studio Get an embedded report (default page)

params.name: reportId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Looker Studio report to embed.

params.name: params
params.description: URL-encoded JSON string containing filter parameters to apply to the embedded report.

items.docs: Returns an embeddable version of a Looker Studio report starting from the default (first) page. This endpoint is used when no specific page ID is required.

info.name: Looker Studio Get report via short link

params.name: shortId
params.description: The short link identifier for the shared report.

items.docs: Access a Looker Studio report using a shortened sharing URL. These URLs are generated by the Looker Studio sharing interface and can be used for oEmbed-compatible embedding on platforms such as Medium and Reddit.
